outer.color_note: Cryostat with integral SHI cold head weighs ~16 kg; cryostat + vertical support stand 23 kg. Stand: two side panels + support cradle on four anti-vibration mounts, four slotted feet for 1 inch / 25 mm optical-table hole patterns; cradle height adjustable so radial window centre height A above table is 55-180 mm. Main OVC body has T-slots on its exterior for radial restraints; the lower tail (optical window block) is 80 mm across ('The dimension across the BLV tail is 80mm.'). Compressor (separate, 3 m He lines): SHI HC4A2 air-cooled 111 kg or HC4E2 water-cooled 82 kg. Shipping blanks are black opaque plastic. Panel/finish colour not published.

notes: Sources: OptistatDry BLV manual MAN-OPTDRY-BLV-2.1.0 Sep 2017 (andor.oxinst.com; robots.txt blocked scripts/v5_snapshot.py so it was fetched with WebFetch and text-extracted with pypdf into the scratchpad), OptistatDry brochure doc 4694 (2018) 'Cool down time from ambient to 4.2 K < 160 minutes at 50 Hz; Typical cooling power 0.2 W at 4.2 K; Optical access 28 mm diameter clear view, f1', Optistat matrix PDF (research/v5/cache/c73e273061693731.txt) and QD-Oxford product page (research/v5/cache/295cbbaf14723ca3.txt). Geometry: vertical cryostat body (OVC with SHI 101D two-stage GM cold head on top, He gas lines entering at the rear), narrowing to an 80 mm optical window block tail at the bottom with four radial window ports (f/1, 28 mm clear view) and one axial port underneath (blanked as standard); each OVC window held by an O-ring and 4 M3 nylon screws, with a matching radiation-shield window/blank held by a spring clip. Radiation shield is cooled by the GM first stage and carries the charcoal sorb on its removable front plate; sample platform/puck bolts to the heat exchanger on the GM second stage. Whole cryostat hangs in a stand with two side panels, cradle on four anti-vibration mounts (M6, 25 mm fine height adjust) and radial restraints in the OVC T-slots. Standard wiring here is the 12-track PCB puck (12P code); the alternative LX20 20-pin option (nine constantan twisted pairs + one copper pair) is not part of this configuration. Vibration <10 um RMS at the sample. Cooldown RT to base ~3.0 h (DC12 puck). Temperature control by Mercury iTC (450 W).
